reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Upgrade procedure: :warning: The Flux APIs `v1beta1` and `v2beta1` (deprecated in 2023) have reached end-of-life and have been removed from the CRDs", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Clusters not deployed via Flux Operator must run `flux migrate` before upgrading, because the v1beta1 and v2beta1 APIs have been removed from the CRDs.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on the cluster before upgrading to Flux 2.7; see the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide.

proposed.statement: Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 were removed from the CRDs; unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, `flux migrate` must be run on clusters before upgrading to 2.7.
